prompt: We have 460 million points with 16-byte vectors. Our calculation says 7-8GB but each instance is using 20GB. We stopped ingestion for a week, barely any queries, still 20GB average across all six instances. What is Qdrant storing that takes 20GB?

assertions.text: Identifies additional RAM consumers beyond raw vectors (HNSW graph, ID tracker, metadata, collection overhead)
Asks about or checks on_disk settings and quantization config
Explains cache behavior (memmap cache inflates reported memory)
Suggests checking collection config to verify what is in RAM vs cached
